project.name: OpenSMART Framework
project.description: Container-based network security monitoring (NSM) stack for Debian 13 + Docker. Bundles passive sensors (Zeek, Suricata, Arkime), a search/analytics backend (OpenSearch), VPN access (OpenVPN, WireGuard), and a reverse-proxy/landing service (nginx). Delivered as a build tree (Dockerfiles) plus a deployment tree (docker compose stacks).
project.purpose: Initial template for an OpenSMART deployment, validated end-to-end on a Debian 13 LXC host.

target_environment.access: configure SSH access according to the target environment

notes: No /dev/net/tun -> OpenVPN server cannot run (PKI/config still generated).
memlock is capped at 8192 bytes by the LXC -> AF_PACKET tpacketv3 ring mmap fails; Arkime uses libpcap and OpenSearch runs with bootstrap.memory_lock=false.
These are host/LXC-level limits, not RAM limits.

networks.name: host
networks.reason: Sensors must sniff the host's eth0 directly.

images.name: opensmart/base
images.purpose: Common Debian 13 base (ca-certificates, curl, iproute2, tini, etc.) for all custom images.

images.name: opensmart/zeek
images.purpose: Zeek NSM. Tool only, no config per spec; container stays idle (sleep infinity).

images.name: opensmart/suricata
images.purpose: Suricata IDS. ET Open ruleset pulled at build; runs live on eth0, logs to /data/log.
images.source: Debian 13 repo (suricata, suricata-update) + ET Open rules

images.name: opensmart/openvpn
images.purpose: Hardened OpenVPN server + PKI tooling. Generates CA/server cert/tls-crypt/CRL and a client template. Server NOT auto-started (no tun).

images.name: opensmart/wireguard
images.purpose: WireGuard server. Generates server keypair + wg0.conf + client template, brings up wg0 (kernel module on host).

images.name: opensearchproject/opensearch:2.18.0
images.purpose: Search/analytics backend for Arkime. Single-node, security plugin disabled.
images.source: Docker Hub (official). Pinned to 2.18.0 to avoid a 2.19.0 zstd/curl hang on Debian 13.

images.name: ghcr.io/arkime/arkime/arkime:v6-latest
images.purpose: Arkime 6 full packet capture + viewer UI. capture (host net) and viewer (opensmart net).
images.source: GitHub Container Registry (official Arkime image, docker.sh wrapper)

services.name: opensearch
services.notes: Security disabled: HTTP API on :9200 has NO authentication. memory_lock off due to LXC memlock cap.

services.name: arkime-capture
services.notes: Runs db.pl init --ifneeded via docker.sh. Sniffs eth0 with libpcap; pcaps in /data/raw.

services.name: arkime-viewer
services.notes: Web UI at http://<host>:8005. Shares node name 'opensmart' and /data/raw with capture.

services.name: suricata
services.notes: suricata -i eth0 -l /data/log. ET Open rules baked in at build.

services.name: zeek
services.notes: Tool-only per spec: container idle (no live capture configured).

services.name: wireguard
services.notes: Server keypair + wg0.conf + client template generated into /data on first start. wg0 up.

services.name: nginx
services.notes: Default nginx landing page; placeholder for future reverse proxy.

services.name: openvpn
services.notes: Excluded from `docker compose up` via profile 'manual' (no /dev/net/tun). PKI generated via `docker compose run --rm openvpn /opt/opensmart/gen-pki.sh`.

credentials.warning: These are INSECURE defaults for a test/template deployment. Rotate before any real use.

opensearch.note: Anyone with network access to :9200 has full read/write. Restrict via firewall or enable the security plugin for production.

tuning.history: Originally tuned for a 4GB host; raised after the reference host was upgraded to 8GB / 6 vCPU.
kept_due_to_lxc_limits: pcapReadMethod=libpcap (afpacketv3 ring blocked by memlock=8192, not RAM)

deploy_procedure: deploy.sh: creates the opensmart network, fixes volume perms (opensearch 1000:1000), starts OpenSearch, brings up Arkime (capture runs db.pl init --ifneeded), waits for arkime_users index, adds admin/changeme, then Suricata/Zeek/WireGuard/nginx, and finally generates the OpenVPN PKI (server stays down).

test_deployment.note: Template and instance share container names, host ports and the opensmart network, so only one runs at a time.

known_issues_and_fixes.symptom: OpenSearch container fails: 'error setting rlimit type 8'

known_issues_and_fixes.cause: docker.sh options placed after node flag
known_issues_and_fixes.fix: put service flags after '--'; init via --db '... init --ifneeded'

known_issues_and_fixes.cause: enrichment files not bundled in image

known_issues_and_fixes.symptom: Arkime: parsers fail to load ('./parsers' not found)

security_notes: Change the Arkime admin password (default admin/changeme) immediately.
OpenSearch :9200 has NO authentication - firewall it or enable the security plugin.
Generated PKI/keys live under each service's volumes/data and are NOT included in this bundle - they are created at deploy time.
OpenVPN/WireGuard client keys are passwordless; protect the generated .ovpn/.conf files.
